data.case_title: Fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) – overdue vehicle inspection, case 32.21-OWI-2027-03390
data.title: Bußgeldbescheid from Stadt Musterhalle – Bußgeldstelle
data.summary: The Bußgeldstelle of Stadt Musterhalle fined Ronja Mustergrund €88.50 for driving the vehicle HAL-RM 63 on 16 March 2027 with its roadworthiness inspection (Hauptuntersuchung) more than eight months overdue, and entered 1 point in the Fahreignungsregister. An objection (Einspruch) is possible within the deadline shown; otherwise the fine becomes final and payable.
data.explanation: This is an official fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) for driving with the vehicle's roadworthiness inspection (Hauptuntersuchung) more than eight months overdue. You may file an objection (Einspruch) if you disagree; the app shows until when you can do this, counted from the delivery date. If you don't object, the fine of €88.50 becomes final, 1 point is added to your driving record (Fahreignungsregister), and the amount must be paid two weeks after it becomes final. Note that if you object, a court could also set a higher fine, so consider getting legal advice before deciding.

remedy.period_text: innerhalb von zwei Wochen ab der Zustellung

remedy.quote: Sie können diesen Bußgeldbescheid mit dem Einspruch anfechten; er muss innerhalb von zwei Wochen ab der Zustellung vorliegen (§ 67 Abs. 1 OWiG), schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Stadt Musterhalle – Bußgeldstelle.

items.title: Decide whether to object (Einspruch) to the fine
items.action: If you disagree with the fine, file a written objection (Einspruch) with the Stadt Musterhalle – Bußgeldstelle, or declare it to their record (zur Niederschrift), by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If no objection is filed in time, the fine becomes final (rechtskräftig), the €88.50 becomes due for payment, and the 1 point stays in the Fahreignungsregister. Note that objecting can also lead to a higher fine if the case goes to court.
items.quote: Sie können diesen Bußgeldbescheid mit dem Einspruch anfechten; er muss innerhalb von zwei Wochen ab der Zustellung vorliegen (§ 67 Abs. 1 OWiG), schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Stadt Musterhalle – Bußgeldstelle.

date.text: innerhalb von zwei Wochen ab der Zustellung

items.title: Pay the fine once it becomes final
items.action: Pay the total amount of €88.50 to the Bußgeldstelle's account once the fine becomes legally final (no objection filed or objection resolved).
items.consequence: Unpaid fines that have become final can lead to further collection or enforcement measures.
items.quote: Der Gesamtbetrag ist zwei Wochen nach Rechtskraft fällig.
